lines.text: The psalm calls for praise from the heavens, starting with all His angels and heavenly hosts.
The sun, moon, shining stars, highest heavens and waters above the skies are called to praise Him.
They should praise because He gave the command and they were created, and He made them last forever.
From the earth, sea creatures, lightning, hail, snow and clouds praise Him, and the powerful wind brings the rain.

wrong_details.wrong: the powerful wind brings the rain
wrong_details.true: the powerful wind fulfills His word

lines.text: Kings, rulers, young and old praise Him, and Israel is a people sent to the nations.
